title: Kururamisira Pakati Pevatengesi
intro: Munhu akamira pamberi pevanhu vakapedzwa neruchiva rwekuwana pfuma, achivadana kuti vave vakatendeseka uye vakarurama mumabasa avo. Muranda waAllah uyu akanyevera nezvekupa chiyero chipfupi uye kunyengedza chikero. Vanhu vakaramba kuteerera, vachityisidzira kudzinga munhu uyu munyika yavo. Nyika pachayo yaizovatonga. Ndiani munhu uyu aimiririra kururamisira pakati pevatengesi?
clues: Ndakatumwa semutumwa kuvanhu vakanga vakanyura mukutengeserana nekutengeserana.
Vanhu vangu vaipa chiyero chidiki pakuyera zvinhu zvevamwe.
Vakandityisidzira kuti vaizondidzinga munyika iyi kana ndikaramba ndichivadana kuti vave nekutenda.
Ndinoyeukwa semunhu ainyanya kutaura zvakanaka pakati pevaprofita.
Vanhu vangu vakabatwa nekudengenyeka kwenyika kwakasimba kwakasiya vasisina hupenyu mudzimba dzavo.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَـٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
verse: They said, "O Shuʿayb, does your prayer [i.e., religion] command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!" (11:87)
